title: The time spent commuting
hook: Two stated cases: explore the weekly time budget behind a commute tradeoff.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the weekly time budget behind a commute tradeoff affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Remaining, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the weekly time budget behind a commute tradeoff in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
